name: Arbran III
description: Arbran III was the third planet in orbit around the star Arbran. It was located in the Arbran system in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Arbran III's surface consisted of ice, and it was orbited by two moons.
